svg.title: Complete measured AND and OR chain panels
svg.desc: Eight rows contain all triples A, B, C from 000 to 111. Four columns show measured A AND B, then its carried AND C, and measured A OR B, then its carried OR C. All outputs match the Boolean targets at the tested phase-zero starts. Digits distinguish values without depending on color. This is a finite panel, not a general reliability estimate.
